verdict.rationale: Khoj can be reached from several clients (Emacs, Obsidian, the desktop app, a browser, WhatsApp), but these are access points for chatting, not paired devices the assistant can control. Nothing in the evidence shows it taking screenshots, using a camera, pushing device notifications, or controlling media playback on other phones or computers. "Play your messages" refers to reading its own replies aloud, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
